text:
aina: heads up — saw a spike in slowpath evictions when onboarding quantized llama variants. dumped traces, looks like a mismatch in kv-key format causing fallback to legacy slowpath.

sam: ack, can you paste a quick trace or sample?

aina: pasted a tiny snippet from the trace: 
```
evict_reason=kv_mismatch
model=llama-quant-v2
route=slowpath
latency_ms=420
```

jeff: hmm — i suspect the admission layer isn't normalizing shard ids post-quantize. runtime treats cache keys as different so it evicts and forces slowpath. we saw similar with int8 last quarter.

maria: is this purely a perf regression or could it impact correctness?

aina: mostly perf right now — some traffic jumps from ~30ms to ~420ms. but higher cost and SLA impact.

leo: quick mitigation idea: router-level deterministic reroute rule. if model.variant matches `quant-*` and we detect kv_signature mismatch, prefer a warm-local fallback (keep serving on same node) instead of full slowpath.

sam: pros: avoids full slowpath and keeps latency low for hot prefixes. cons: risk of returning stale kv data if signatures are truly incompatible.

jeff: we can add a lightweight signature-distance check: compare prefix-hash Hamming distance; if distance <= 1 then allow local fallback; else go full slowpath. we need telemetry to validate correctness.

maria: on the onboarding bench side, we'll need a smoke that simulates kv mismatch and measures latency deltas and error/diff rates. this should be part of the model intake checks.

aina: agreed. propose two deliverables:
1) router reroute policy config (example):
```
reroute:
  quant_signatures:
    threshold_hamming: 1
    fallthrough: warm-local
```
2) bench case: `kv-mismatch-warm-fallback` to replay golden prefixes and assert output parity/tolerances.

devops-bot: deploy request created #deploys/benches 1751239889 by @aina

sam: also add an alert: if warm-local fallback causes error-rate > 0.1% or output-diff > X then automatically revert the policy.

jeff: implementation plan: i'll own the router change (small PR). maria, can you add the bench and smoke tests? aina will gather and upload traces. target: PRs by EOD friday.

maria: yes, i'll add the harness and a canonical-prefix test. should be a small patch.

aina: thanks — i'll push the traces to s3 and tag `slowpath-quant-175123`.

leo: one more thought — for Dedicated customers we should expose this as a stricter opt-in flag (off by default) documented in onboarding guide. avoids surprising tenants.

sam: noted. any objections? :thumbsup:

jeff: :thumbsup:

aina: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

(ends)
